name: initialize_record_from_lookup

name: clear_record_field_status
description: Zeroes a four-byte field of the record addressed by a register and returns minus one. Its only other effect is a single call to a helper.

name: return_stack_argument_unchanged
description: Returns its stack argument unchanged and touches no other state. Four unnamed routines call it.

name: analyze_undecompiled_handler_body
description: The decompiler produced no pseudo-code for this seven-instruction routine, so its behaviour cannot be read. It is reached through a handler pointer held in data and is called from a data pointer in the first hunk.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:171EA
name: claim_record_for_empty_cell
description: Checks that a cell of a global byte table is empty for the position given in two input registers, then claims the first free record in the list and sets its type, position, and a timer taken from a helper's result. Returns one on success and zero otherwise.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:17236
name: set_marker_and_initialize_record
description: Writes a constant marker byte through an address register, then fills a record addressed by another register with a type, a position, and a timer computed from a helper's result. Returns one.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:17290
name: pass_stack_argument_through
description: Returns its stack argument unchanged and touches no other state. Two unnamed routines call it.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:172A4
name: claim_free_record_with_defaults
description: Claims the first unused fixed-size record, sets its in-use byte, and clears its position. It copies two input bytes into the record only when a global table entry at the given index is non-zero, then stores a fixed mode value and a global default word.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:172C4
name: initialize_record_fields_from_input
description: Sets the in-use byte and clears the position of a record addressed by a register. It copies two input bytes into the record when a global table entry at the given index is non-zero, then stores a fixed mode value and a global default word.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:172FE
name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns zero with no side effects. Two unnamed routines call it.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1730E
name: set_flag_for_linked_entries
description: Walks a linked list of entries that starts at a table slot chosen by two input bytes. Entries whose type byte is below five and whose compare byte differs from the input get a flag bit set and a constant word written, and the routine returns one if any entry changed.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1735A
name: mark_cell_if_nibble_full
description: Reads a position from a structure addressed by a register and looks up a cell in a global byte table. It writes a constant to the cell when the cell's low four bits are all set and a higher bit is clear, then returns its first data register unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:173A8
name: return_stack_argument_as_is
description: Returns its stack argument unchanged and touches no other state. One unnamed routine calls it.

name: process_global_table_entries
description: Walks a short table terminated by a sentinel value and, for each entry, computes an index from two input bytes plus the entry value. Where the index passes a mask test it follows a linked list of entries, changing the type of matching nodes, writing constants into their fields, and calling a helper for nodes of one specific type.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:17446
name: clear_record_inuse_flag
description: Clears the byte at the in-use offset of the record addressed by a register. That is the same byte the allocation routines test to find an unused record.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1744C
name: iterate_handler_table
description: Walks a table of handler entries stored in global data, calling each handler indirectly and then clearing a byte and a word in the structure it returns, until the walk passes a fixed end address. It returns its two input values unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:17500
name: inspect_undecompiled_routine_body
description: The decompiler gave no pseudo-code for this twelve-instruction routine, so only its size and callers are known. It is reached through a handler pointer held in data and is called from data pointers and one unnamed routine.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:17E9A
name: check_and_update_table_entry
description: Looks up a 16-bit value in a table at the current global index and, when the value is non-zero and within a limit, advances the index. It sets a state variable to a small constant (a lower one if a second global holds a fixed value), copies two bytes from a parallel table, and calls a helper.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:17EEC
name: run_delayed_polling_loop
description: Runs nested loops over helper calls and status checks, pausing in two busy-wait countdowns of one hundred thousand steps each, and leaves through a common exit when a check fails. The routine also references the short text ABCD.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1802E
name: run_status_checked_scan_loop
description: Runs loops over helper calls that return status values, choosing between two scanning paths by a state byte. One path walks a table of entries up to a fixed end address, and the other calls helpers directly. The loops exit early as soon as a status is non-zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:180A4
name: scan_tables_and_set_modes
description: Walks a table of entries up to a fixed end address, then runs a countdown loop over helper calls. It finally sets two mode globals in an order chosen by a state byte and copies a stored value into another global.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:18186
name: call_helper_return_argument
description: Calls one helper routine and then returns the eight-byte stack argument unchanged. One unnamed routine calls it.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1819A
name: return_stack_value_after_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the eight-byte value passed on the stack unchanged. Four unnamed routines call it.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:181C0
name: check_state_and_merge_flags
description: Tests a state byte in a structure reached through a global pointer. When it equals six or eight, it runs a counted loop and then ORs saved flag words into two globals. It returns one if the loop exits early and zero otherwise.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1826E
name: remap_entry_state_bytes
description: Calls a helper, then visits three structures in a table reached through a global pointer. Each non-zero state byte at a fixed offset becomes two if it was two or six, and four otherwise. It sets a global to four and returns its input registers unchanged.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:182C6
name: clear_and_negate_flag_tables
description: Clears each non-zero entry of a table of five-short records and calls a helper for entries whose follow-up field is set. It then walks a second table of shorts, calling a helper with a bit mask for each positive entry and clearing or keeping entries depending on the result, and negates every entry.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:182CA
name: clear_and_negate_flag_tables
description: Clears each non-zero entry of a table of five-short records and calls a helper for entries whose follow-up field is set. It then walks a second table of shorts, calling a helper with a bit mask for each positive entry and clearing or keeping entries depending on the result, and negates every entry.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:182CE
name: clear_flags_and_process_table
description: Clears each non-zero entry of a block of short flags, calling a helper and an extra helper when a related entry is set. It then walks a second table of short entries, calling a helper with a bit mask for each non-zero entry and negating every entry.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:183B6
name: toggle_table_entry_with_masks
description: Indexes a table of short entries by a byte in the input structure and compares the entry with a computed key. A matching entry is negated, and an empty entry is set to the negated key followed by two calls with bit masks derived from the input.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:18426
name: send_bit_mask_sequence
description: Calls a helper with each single-bit value one, two, four and eight, each combined with a fixed high flag. It makes one further call with a fixed constant when a global variable is non-zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1842E
name: send_bit_mask_sequence
description: Calls a helper with each single-bit value one, two, four and eight, each combined with a fixed high flag. It makes one further call with a fixed constant when a global variable is non-zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:18474
name: update_global_flag_and_table
description: Checks a global flag. When the flag is zero it calls a helper twice with values built from a constant table entry and a bit shift; otherwise it calls the helper twice with fixed constants. It returns no value.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:184F6
name: update_entry_flags_and_neighbor
description: Indexes a table of entries by the first input and calls a helper twice with values derived from the entry's data. If the entry's linked index is non-zero, it repeats both calls for the referenced entry, then returns the two input arguments combined.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:18ADA
name: check_flag_and_call_twice
description: When a global flag is non-zero, it stores the flag plus four into one global and the address of another global into a second, then calls two helpers. It does nothing when the flag is zero.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:18EE4
name: initialize_interrupt_handlers
description: Writes pointers to a shared data block and to handler routines into many RAM locations and sets a few bytes. It registers an interrupt server through the Exec library, touches the CIA-B timer and interrupt control registers, and then calls an indirect routine through a table.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:190B8
name: remove_interrupt_server_if_active
description: Removes an interrupt server through the Exec library when a counter is positive, and touches the CIA-B interrupt control register and the DMA control register. It calls an indirect routine through a table in between and then sets a state global.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:190E4
name: apply_mask_flags_to_records
description: Walks four records through pointers kept in a global table and, for each record chosen by the low four bits of the parameter, writes flag bytes and words according to the parameter's mask bits. It calls a helper for one mask case and updates a global flag word when certain bits are set.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1922A
name: search_triple_table_for_value
description: Walks a table of three-short entries from the address in an address register, stopping at a zero terminator or at the first entry equal to the input value. It returns no value and leaves the match position in the address register.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1926C
name: analyze_undecompiled_routine_body
description: The decompiler timed out and gave no pseudo-code for this 49-instruction routine. The facts show only that one unnamed routine calls it and that it is reached through a handler pointer held in data.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1932C
name: process_flagged_entities
description: Takes a 64-bit value from a helper and processes the four records whose bits are set in its low nibble. For each one it writes flag bytes and status bits according to the value's bits, and it calls a helper when a clear-or-continue bit is set.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1942A
name: update_four_channel_registers
description: When a pending byte is set it clears that byte and decrements a counter, then loops over four channels writing per-channel values into a block of hardware registers. It touches the CIA-B interrupt control and DMA control registers and calls helpers for channels with a set flag.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:194E2
name: run_four_entry_state_loop
description: Loops over four entries and applies a per-entry state code to each. It either writes a status word or looks up a value in a table and stores it with an address, then clears the entry's flag. It touches the DMA control register and calls two helpers.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1950E
name: update_four_entry_states
description: Repeats the per-entry state update for four entries. Each entry gets a looked-up value and an address stored into it, its flag is cleared, and a helper is called before the loop advances to the next entry.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1953A
name: write_four_entry_channel_values
description: Loops over four entries and copies each entry's two stored words into a block of hardware registers at a fixed stride. For entries with a pending flag it handles a state change or table lookup and stores the result.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1956C
name: advance_sequence_step_counter
description: Advances a stepped sequence structure by one tick. It applies an accumulated offset when a flag is set and returns the difference between that value and an input, clamped to zero when negative. When a repeat count is reached it moves to the next group and sets a status bit when the sequence ends.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1960A
name: set_record_status_flag
description: Sets the status bit with value four in the byte at offset eleven of the record addressed by a register.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19612
name: step_record_byte_sequence
description: Updates a record that plays through a byte sequence. It adjusts stored counters toward a target, and when its timer runs out it reads the next sequence byte, ending the sequence at a terminator and applying a lookup-table value to the record. Pending flags are cleared on exit.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1965C
name: advance_record_sequence_timer
description: Decrements the timer field of a record and, when it reaches zero, reads the next entries of a sequence. It handles terminator bytes, updates table values for a paired record, and calls helpers along the way.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:196E4
name: initialize_records_from_sequence
description: For each byte in a sequence block it sets a count field, looks up a value in a table at an offset, and writes a cleared state into a target record. It repeats until the sequence ends.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:196F0
name: initialize_records_from_sequence
description: Initializes target records from a sequence block using the same pattern as its neighbouring routine. For each sequence byte it looks up a value, clears a target record's state, and sets its active bit, until a terminator is read.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19712
name: initialize_paired_records_from_sequence
description: Initializes a pair of records for each sequence byte. It looks up a value in a table using the byte plus an offset from the record, clears both records' state fields, and sets their active bits. It calls a helper and continues until the sequence terminator.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1978C
name: decode_sequence_command_byte
description: Decodes one command byte from a sequence. Depending on its flag bits it stores a masked table value into a record, sets a field from the low five bits, or configures a record from a table entry, and it returns when a stop bit is set.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:197A4
name: finalize_sequence_record_state
description: Stores two table-derived bytes into the record and runs the sequence's termination check. It clears the active bit on the linked record, marks the record as done, and returns.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:197BE
name: configure_record_from_command_byte
description: Handles a command byte. When its stop bit is clear it sets up a record from the table entry addressed by the low five bits and marks the record active, then runs the same termination check as its neighbouring routines.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:1980E
name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing and returns. One unnamed routine calls it.

key: populous ii - trials of the olympian gods (1991)(electronic arts)[cr vf][f ip](disk 1 of 2)[a]/Populous II - Trials of the Olympian Gods (1991)(Electronic Arts)[cr VF][f IP](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:POPULOUS.II:0:19820
name: compute_clamped_record_offset
description: Takes a value from a helper and subtracts a threshold derived from a record field and a stored byte. Negative results are clamped to zero, the low byte is stored in the record, and the resulting word is passed to another helper.
